title: Matix3005's size datapack
description: A minecraft datapack that let's you shrink and grow using the /tag command.
body:
**Welcome to my datapack.** This datapack is only available on version 26.1.2, but I will be adding support for diffrent versions. To use the datapack you need the acces to commands, more specifically the /tag command. To make a player mini you need to give them the tag "mini", for example:\
**/tag Matix3005 add mini**\
There's also a way to make a player grow, for example:\
**/tag Matix3005 add xl**\
To reset a player to the deafult size you need to give them the "reset" tag, for example:\
**/tag Matix3005 add reset**\
After any of these tags are given any of thoose tags:\
1. all of the changes will be made, like changing the size of the player.
2. the tag will be removed after all the changes were made.
